description: Free keyless email-deliverability preview. Grades ONE address in full (real output): syntax, MX / implicit-MX routing, email provider, SPF/DMARC posture, disposable / role / free-provider flags, a derived edit-distance typo did-you-mean, and an A-F deliverability grade — no SMTP ping, no account. Any additional addresses return only {deliverable, grade}. A real taste of the paid /email/verify, which returns the full per-email record for up to 100 addresses in one x402 call — call get_premium_access for the metered endpoint.

email.description: A single email address to grade in full ("jane@stripe.com").

emails.description: Optional list: the first is graded in full, the next few return only {deliverable, grade}. Use `email` for a single address.

name: verify_email_preview
